component.name: Giemon robot manufacturing plant — R0 building + equipment BOM

properties.name: giemon:note
properties.value: R0 design BOM for an 80m x 50m single-bay light-assembly plant (full MEP + 外構) that manufactures the giemon robot line. Building shell (A-E) + utilities (G electrical / H water / I gas / J fire) routed as kami-genesis geometry; site/外部動線 (K) outside the bay; raw materials (L) as bulk inputs; equipment (F) as CAD + giemon arm6 work-cells. Manufacturer/MPN/数量/length-m/area-m2 are representative R0 design figures, NOT a finalized purchase, 確認申請, 消防同意, or 受電/受水/ガス供給契約.
